title: AM-MODEL-REPOSITORY-STANDARD declaration (standard.yaml)
description: Validates the repository-standard adoption declaration of an Assessment-Models maturity-model repository (CR-AM-ORG-RES-000). model.yaml remains the authoritative identity manifest; this declaration cross-references it and is CI-checked for coherence. Since standard v1.0.1, an optional structure block may record explicit structure mappings (rule R1: map, never rename).

type.description: Must equal model.yaml type. Only maturity-model repositories adopt this standard.

version.description: Published SemVer version of the standard this repository conforms to.

name.description: Human-readable model name; must equal model.yaml name.

version.description: Must equal model.yaml version and the VERSION file; cross-checked by CI.

structure.description: Optional (standard v1.0.1). Records explicit structure mappings: established alternative paths satisfying a structural role (rule R1: map, never rename). Mappings declare existing structure; they are reviewed like any declaration change and never excuse missing baseline files.

model-definition.description: The authoritative model definition role (default path: maturity/model).

paths.description: Established paths serving the role; each must exist (CI-checked).

note.description: Why the structure differs (e.g. composite model definition).
